Description: The European Commission, in line with the New European Bauhaus (NEB) initiative, aims to create an interactive IT platform called the ‘NEB Funding Hub-. This platform will facilitate the matchmaking of small-scale projects that align with the core NEB values (sustainability, inclusion, and quality of experience) with appropriate funding sources, including public and private financiers, as well as crowdfunding entities. The platform will support the identification, ranking, and financing of NEB-related projects with a funding requirement of up to an estimative value of EUR 100,000.
